name: Propeller Pete
detailed_description:
Welcome to Lakehart International Airport

Step into the abandoned terminals of Kiwi Airlines, where the echoes of a long-forgotten aviation disaster still linger. In Propeller Pete, you investigate the ruins of an airport linked to a doomed flight... one that was carrying an experimental aircraft system.

Use Your Tools to Solve the Mystery

Uncover the airport's dark history and trace the origins of the deadly experiments. Only you can piece together the truth.

Don't Become the Next Victim

Once the friendly face of Kiwi Airlines, Propeller Pete was a beloved mascot meant to symbolize safe travel. But after the mysterious shutdown of the airline, strange stories emerged about the abandoned airport. Something still moves in the shadows, and Pete may not be just a memory.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 / 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6500 / AMD Ryzen 5 1600.
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia Geforce GTX 1060 / AMD Radeon RX 570
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
